summary: Grayscale Horizen Trust (ZEN) filed an 8-K solely to disclose a change in its valuation index effective September 1, 2026, switching from the CoinDesk Horizen Reference Rate to the CoinDesk Horizen Benchmark Extended Rate for calculating NAV. The filing describes the new index methodology, including constituent selection criteria and anti-manipulation measures. This is a routine operational update with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, redemptions, or strategic actions. No deal terms apply, and there is no board recommendation or advisor involvement. Watch for potential NAV volatility but no risk-arb angle.
